subject: E-5181: cannot write data directory on macOS
body:
Good morning. My setup is CourierOS 3.5.2, macOS 14.7.
Whenever I open the app since yesterday, the app shows
'E-5181: cannot write to data directory'.

Our data folder is on a mapped network share, not the local
disk. After sleep the share takes a while to reconnect.

What I tried so far: rebooting the router. No luck.

Thanks, Priya Nair (Harbour Freight)
